title: Agile capacity playbook and scope-pruning guidelines for cycle planning
creator: Marcus Lee
description: Objective: Create a compact, repeatable playbook product teams can use during cycle kickoff to (1) convert high-level OKRs into staffable milestones, (2) allocate core capacity vs surge lanes, and (3) apply defensible scope-pruning rules when capacity is constrained. Scope: product-management + Eng leads + Design: standardize inputs, decision gates, and escalation paths so Program Managers can deliver consistent capacity tradeoffs across teams. Deliverables: 1) one-page playbook doc, 2) decision rubric (priority scoring), 3) staff allocation template (FTE->points mapping), 4) emergency scope-cut checklist and developer-friendly examples.
updates: 2026-02-20: Draft created by Marcus; initial outline and section headings added.
